text: Bitcoin is holding ground near $77K with minimal movement, while Ethereum stalled at $2,433—a sign of consolidation rather than conviction despite elevated sentiment. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 73 (greed) with a sharp 42-point weekly surge suggests retail optimism is running ahead of price action, particularly as Bitcoin dominance climbed to 59.3%, indicating capital rotation into the largest assets. Volume at $90B remains solid but not exceptional, implying traders are cautious about committing fresh capital into what appears to be a pause before directional confirmation.
